messages:
Maya: Flagging a new ask from a customer: they want an official 'sticky version exemption' for a model family used in regulated translation. They want deterministic migration windows, audit trail, and a way to opt into a compatibility shim. Can we map product options?
Evan: Sticky versions are ok as a paid add-on, but we need clear limits: TTL, renewal flow, and an auto-unpin safety. Also call out quantization or optimizer changes that may force a migration.
Sophia: Bench needs to cover fidelity + safety: perf (p95 @512 <= 350ms), fidelity delta <=1% on customer test-suite, embedding stability >=0.95 cosine, and safety regression checks. Also include a regression veto on critical prompts.
Marco: Ops red flag: multiple sticky requests fragment capacity and impact packing. Recommend a "Sticky Pool" reserved tier or require Dedicated for full guarantees. We can offer a Temporary Surge Reserve for contract setup windows.
Maya: Proposed product matrix:
- Sticky-lite (Hosted): 60d sticky with auto-unpin, canary requirement, SLA best-effort, small surcharge.
- Sticky-plus (Reserved Pool): 90-120d billed reservation, guaranteed SLA (p95 cap), migration notice 10 business days, audit logs, rollback window 3 days.
- Dedicated sticky: Customer-managed capacity, SLA credits, longer retention.
Evan: For Hosted reserved tier we need a capacity delta estimate + a policy for simultaneous stickies (min-commit or slot limits).
ops-bot: Bench score suggestion: `score = 0.45*latency_norm + 0.35*quality_norm + 0.2*stability_norm`. Gate: score >= 0.80 and no safety triggers.
Sophia: Launch gates suggestion:
1) Bench suite definition & baseline runs (perf/quality/safety)
2) Capacity delta + infra approval for Sticky Pool
3) Legal retention addendum + migration veto language
4) Canary infra + customer canary run(s): either 2 customers or 1 customer + 1 internal
5) Telemetry & regression alerts enabled
Marco: Action items:
- Eng (Marco + infra) -> capacity model + canary infra (3 business days)
- Product (Maya + Sophia) -> bench spec + pricing matrix (EOW)
- Legal/GTM -> draft retention addendum & audit log SLAs (2 business days)
- CS -> collect customer test-suite & traffic patten samples (Priya to own)
Maya: Operational notes: include an "interop shim" option to run new model under a compatibility wrapper for 14 days to reduce fidelity deltas. Also add an explicit auto-unpin TTL and renewal workflow.
Evan: Also add a migration escalation path: if bench fails post-migration, customer can trigger rollback within 72 hours and we have to provide a remediation plan.
Sophia: I'll build the initial bench matrix and example test prompts, will upload to /mnt/onboard/sticky-exemptions.
Maya: Let's reconvene after infra posts the cost delta. If infra flags capacity constraints, default to Dedicated-only for longer stickies. Thanks all.
